message.reasoning_content:
Verify: read answer.txt and compare with extracted value; also verify no other TOKEN occurrences in full output and that full output is 4001 lines.

Let me do a verification: diff between answer.txt content (stripped) and grep-extracted value.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "echo \"--- answer.txt ---\"; cat -A answer.txt; echo \"--- check ---\"; [ \"$(grep -o 'TOKEN=[^[:space:]]*' /tmp/gen.out | sed 's/^TOKEN=//')\" = \"$(tr -d '\\n' < answer.txt)\" ] && echo MATCH || echo MISMATCH; wc -l < /tmp/gen.out"}
